name: RFsim
description: S-parameter simulation of PCB structures with openEMS
description_full: RFsim simulates the S-parameters of an RF structure directly in the PCB editor, with the openEMS FDTD solver, for any number of ports. It plots the magnitude, the phase, a Smith chart, the VSWR and the group delay, and it writes a Touchstone (.sNp) file. It also calculates the far field, and it animates the E-field and the H-field. The geometry comes directly from the board: the pads, tracks, vias, zones and the R/L/C parts.
